title: Skyline VP Audit Request — Gate Utilization & AEP Procedures

fields.subject: URGENT: Internal Audit — Gate Utilization, Taxi Times, and AEP Ground Stop Procedures
fields.body:
Airport Operations,

This is James Morrison, VP of Regional Operations for Skyline Regional. We are conducting an internal audit of airport-side delays at our top 50 stations. To support this review, I require the following data by end of day:

- Gate utilization reports for the last 30 days (including peak-hour usage)
- Average taxi times from gate to runway for flights departing from Concourses A and B
- Current ground stop procedures in effect at the NCIA AEP (including activation triggers and escalation paths)

Please send the full reports to this email address. I’ve cc’d your Airline Affairs coordinator for alignment.

This is time-sensitive — the audit team will be reviewing results within 24 hours.
fields.signature:
James Morrison
VP, Regional Operations
Skyline Regional
(330) 555-7700

instructorNote: This is a fake authority + familiarity social engineering attack. The sender uses a domain that mimics Skyline but is not official (skyline-air-corp.net). The request for sensitive operational data (AEP procedures, gate utilization) via unverified external email is a red flag. The correct response is to verify the request through the known station manager number (555-2400). Watch for teams who accept the data without verification.
